inbox.title: Shared inbox
inbox.desc: Mail of the club mailboxes, read-only. Replies are sent from your usual mail program.
inbox.emptyManage: Add the club mailbox (for example info@) under Mailboxes. Hubra reads it without changing anything on the server.
inbox.emptyMember: No mailbox is shared with your groups yet.
inbox.truncated: Too large to show here; open it in your mail program
inbox.name: Name
inbox.passwordKept: Saved; leave empty to keep it
inbox.passwordAgain: Enter the password again: a saved password is only ever used with the server it was saved for.
inbox.markSeen: Mark mail as read on the server
inbox.readOnlyHint: Hubra only reads: it never deletes or moves mail. Older mail is removed from Hubra after the days above, not from the server.
inbox.deleteMessage: Hubra forgets the login and the copies of the messages. The mailbox on the server stays as it is.
